scope.scope_reference: Effective only after exact owner authorization on the verified macOS 26.2 arm64, Codex CLI 0.166.0 host. See READINESS.md.

designer.rationale: Construct an independent, reviewable history, chronology and control.

author.rationale: Produce one limited perspective and genre-constrained Source.

realism.rationale: Check retainer, custody, chronology and cues condition by condition.

annotation.rationale: Read the locked file independently and attach complete exact Evidence.

adjudication.rationale: Resolve peer disagreements and lock all key and proof commitments.

audit.rationale: Challenge shortcuts, audit sufficient proofs and precommit appropriate masks.

masked.rationale: Read a neutral reduced packet independently against the same high standard.

stop_conditions: Halt the task on a shared isolation incident or unverified approval or implementation commitment.
Halt the affected family on uncertainty, integrity failure, the family or task allowance, unresolved realism or evidence objection, or a new hypothesis or repair outside the authorized scope.
Stop at consolidated human admission review. Expansion, baseline and evaluation require distinct authority.
